MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor Gorilla tape fits my previous repair-tape purchases, and weather resistance gives me a concrete reason to choose it for outdoor repairs.",
    "The metal epoxy fits durable repair work suggested by my clamps and adhesive purchases, while the sealed wire connectors offer a useful connection option beyond my existing spade terminals."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Painter's tape and steel wool serve painting or surface-finishing tasks that I do not currently have; being workshop supplies does not make them useful next purchases.",
    "The washers and screws require particular sizes and fastening jobs, while black plastic bonder needs a suitable plastic repair. My history does not establish those needs.",
    "Ten tubes of super glue and two cans of lubricant exceed what I can justify buying without a specific immediate use."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any maintenance or hardware supply.",
    "My use of tape and adhesive seems to have been stretched across products with different purposes, such as masking tape and rigid-plastic bonder."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repair material and connection method matter to me: weatherproof tape, metal epoxy and sealed wire joints each solve a recognizable problem.",
    "Quantity and exact fit matter alongside general usefulness; a familiar brand or related tool does not establish that I need a bulk pack or a particular fastener size."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but sometimes mistake a related supply for something I have a concrete reason to buy now."
}
